headline: Cohort-5 vendors are the four LARGEST multi-purpose consumer-electronics OUI holders on the IEEE registry (Apple 1513, Samsung 953, Amazon 205, Google 106 OUI rows). The DOMINANT ruling here is §11 #10 (do NOT categorize at OUI level for multi-purpose vendors): all 2,748 net-new parent-company OUIs span phones/tablets/TVs/laptops/watches/earbuds/routers and are NOT separable to the hub/voice-assistant SKU -> bulk OUI promotion = 0. The CP10 narrow-read carve-out (single-product-line §2.1 vendors) does NOT apply. The ONLY cleanly-attributable OUI candidate is the pure-play smart-home-hub brand SmartThings, Inc. (24:fd:5b, NET-NEW). Nest Labs (2 NET-NEW OUIs) is brand-scoped but still multi-product (Hub vs Cam vs Thermostat). BLE net-new = 0 (BT SIG registry fully bulk-loaded; many vendor member-UUIDs already categorized bluetooth_tracker via cohort-3 -> recat-to-hub would COLLIDE).

flagged_for_cto: TAXONOMY ONE-WAY-DOOR (x2 proposed categories): neither 'smart_home_hub' nor 'voice_assistant' exists. Board must decide (a) mint one/both vs map-to-existing, AND (b) which device-class the cohort vendors map to. Until then all leads are §11 #13 export-banned. CTO -> CEO.

§11 #10 IS THE DOMINANT RULING: Amazon/Google/Apple/Samsung are the textbook multi-purpose vendors (Apple 1513 OUIs span iPhone/iPad/Mac/Watch/AirPods/AppleTV/HomePod). NONE of the 2,748 net-new parent OUIs is promotable at OUI level. CP10 narrow-read carve-out does NOT apply (these are not single-product-line §2.1 vendors). Recommend: do NOT bulk-promote parent OUIs under any category.

CLEANEST (and nearly ONLY) promotable lead: SmartThings, Inc. 24:fd:5b (oui, NET-NEW, MA-L). Pure-play smart-home-hub brand; the SmartThings Hub is the literal cohort device. Strong smart_home_hub candidate IF the category is minted.

Nest Labs Inc. 64:16:66 + 18:b4:30 (oui, NET-NEW): brand-scoped but multi-product. Nest Hub = cohort device, but Nest Cam = cctv_camera and Nest Thermostat = neither. OUI cannot be split Hub-vs-Cam -> caveat; needs product anchor or stays unclean. ALSO overlaps the cctv_camera lane (double-promotion guard with any future Nest Cam OUI work).

DOUBLE-PROMOTION GUARD (task-requested, FIRES): Ring 13 OUIs (id44471-83) + Blink 5 OUIs (id44492-96) are already device_category='cctv_camera' (wave-1 MAC-378). Ring/Blink are camera/doorbell brands, NOT hubs/voice-assistants -> they belong to cctv_camera, do NOT recat to hub. The 2 'Ring'-named net-new IEEE rows are name-collision FPs (Ring Solutions=Malvern PA; RING ACCESS=legacy 00:40:40 block) -> reject.

BLE recat-COLLISION (do-not-double-promote, like Wyze in c4): ~19 Apple+Samsung member-UUIDs are ALREADY device_category='bluetooth_tracker' (cohort-3 Find-My/SmartTag, id44416-51). These are phone/tracker ecosystem UUIDs, NOT hub-specific. Recat-to-hub would collide AND mis-attribute. Recommend NO BLE recat for cohort-5.
